tips:
## Digital Vocabulary

Technology terms in Hebrew — some are borrowed from English, others are native Hebrew:

| Hebrew | Origin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| אינטרנט | English | internet |
| אפליקציה | English | app/application |
| מחשב | Hebrew (from חשב = think) | computer |
| מסך | Hebrew | screen |
| סיסמה | Hebrew | password |
| אתר | Hebrew | website |
| עדכון | Hebrew (from עדכן = update) | update |

### Useful Digital Verbs
- **להוריד** (lehorid) — to download (Hif'il of ירד, to go down)
- **לגלוש** (liglosh) — to browse/surf
- **לעדכן** (le'adken) — to update
- **למחוק** (limkhok) — to delete
- **לאפס** (le'apes) — to reset

### Email
**דואר אלקטרוני** (do'ar elektroni) literally means "electronic mail." In casual speech, many Israelis just say **אימייל** (email) or **מייל** (mail).

Note: **להוריד** literally means "to bring down" — it's the same verb used for downloading files and going down stairs!
